Select mb samples from hypoad and all samples from tsai mb dataset
```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(BPCells)
library(khroma)
library(harmony)
hypoad_ge = open_matrix_dir("./hypoad_prepro/hypoad_counts_bpcells_mat/")
cell_meta = readRDS("./hypoad_prepro/cell_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")

rna_and_pmi_info = read_csv("./hypoad_prepro/rna and pmi donor info.csv")
rna_and_pmi_info = rna_and_pmi_info[1:14,]
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format= rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format %>% as.character()
#from stack overflow
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal = 
sapply(strsplit(rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format,":"),
  function(x) {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    x[1]+x[2]/60
    }
)
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal = rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal %>% scale()
rna_and_pmi_info$rna_integrity_score = rna_and_pmi_info$rna_integrity_score %>% scale
#copy donor metadata from table 2 
cell_meta$pmi_hours = rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal[match(cell_meta$donor_id,rna_and_pmi_info$cell_meta_id)] 
cell_meta$rna_integrity_score = rna_and_pmi_info$rna_integrity_score[match(cell_meta$donor_id,rna_and_pmi_info$cell_meta_id)]
hypoad_cell_meta_mb = cell_meta %>% filter(is_primary_data) %>% filter(dissection == "MM")
hypoad_ge_mb = hypoad_ge[,rownames(hypoad_cell_meta_mb)]
library(tidyverse)
library(BPCells)

mb_counts_df = readRDS("./rosmap_mb_prepro/doublet and initial cell types pre qc.rds")
singlet_cells = mb_counts_df %>% filter(scDblFinder_class == "singlet")
mb_counts = open_matrix_dir("./rosmap_mb_prepro/decontx_counts/")
mb_counts = mb_counts[,singlet_cells$cell_id]

reads_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(mb_counts)
genes_expressed_per_cell = Matrix::colSums(mb_counts > 0)
qc_df <- data.frame(umis = reads_per_cell, genes_detected = genes_expressed_per_cell)

# Identify mitochondrial genes (human convention)
mt_genes <- grep("^MT-", rownames(mb_counts), value = TRUE)

# Percent of each cell's UMIs coming from mito genes
qc_df$pct_mito <- 100 * Matrix::colSums(mb_counts[mt_genes, , drop = FALSE]) / qc_df$umis
library(ggplot2)
qc_pass <- qc_df$umis >= 2000 &
           qc_df$umis <= 1e5 & #catch any remaining multiplets (sequenced high, but prob not necessary)
           qc_df$genes_detected >= 500 &
           qc_df$pct_mito <= 5

cat("Cells before QC:", nrow(qc_df), "\n")
cat("Cells passing QC:", sum(qc_pass),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * mean(qc_pass)))



mb_counts <- mb_counts[, qc_pass]
meta_mb_tsai = singlet_cells[match(colnames(mb_counts),singlet_cells$cell_id),]

shared_genes = intersect(rownames(mb_counts),rownames(hypoad_ge_mb))
mb_counts = mb_counts[shared_genes,]
hypoad_ge_mb = hypoad_ge_mb[shared_genes,]

meta_mb_tsai = meta_mb_tsai %>% select(cell_id, sample)
meta_mb_tsai$dataset = "tsai"
hypoad_cell_meta_mb = hypoad_cell_meta_mb %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% rename("sample" = "donor_id")
hypoad_cell_meta_mb = hypoad_cell_meta_mb %>% select(cell_id, sample)
hypoad_cell_meta_mb$dataset = "hypoad"
combined_meta = bind_rows(meta_mb_tsai,hypoad_cell_meta_mb)
combined_ge = cbind(mb_counts,hypoad_ge_mb)

get_pcs_from_initial_dataset = function(initial_ge_matrix, n_var_genes = 2000, nthreads = 8, npcs = 30) {
  initial_ge_matrix <- multiply_cols(initial_ge_matrix, 1/Matrix::colSums(initial_ge_matrix))
  initial_ge_matrix <- log1p(initial_ge_matrix * 1e4) # Log transform
  #stats <- matrix_stats(initial_ge_matrix, row_stats="variance", threads = nthreads)
  # Variable Gene Selection Using Seurat VST 
  variable_genes <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(initial_ge_matrix, nfeatures = n_var_genes) 
  variable_genes = variable_genes %>% filter(variable == T) 
  variable_genes$gene = rownames(variable_genes)
  variable_genes$standard_deviation = sqrt(variable_genes$variance)
  gene_means <- variable_genes$mean
  gene_std <- variable_genes$standard_deviation
  initial_ge_matrix <- initial_ge_matrix[variable_genes$gene,]
  #write to disk before breaking sparsity via z-score
  preprocessed_ge = initial_ge_matrix %>% write_matrix_dir(tempfile("mat"), overwrite = T)
  #z-score
  preprocessed_ge <- (preprocessed_ge - gene_means) / gene_std
  #calculate 30 PCs 
  svd <- BPCells::svds(preprocessed_ge, k = npcs, threads = nthreads)
  pca <- multiply_cols(svd$v, svd$d)
  rownames(pca) = colnames(preprocessed_ge)
  colnames(pca) = paste("PC_",seq(1,ncol(pca)))
  return(pca)

}

create_snn_graph_from_pcs <- function(pc_coords, knns_returned = 20, M_index_build_param = 100, ef_index_build_param = 200, ef_index_search_param = 200, distance_metric = "euclidean", n_threads = 8) {
  hnsw_index <- RcppHNSW::hnsw_build(
    X = pc_coords,
    ef = ef_index_build_param,
    M = M_index_build_param,
    distance = distance_metric,
    n_threads = n_threads
  )
  nn_index <- RcppHNSW::hnsw_search(
    X = pc_coords,
    ann = hnsw_index,
    k = knns_returned,
    ef = 200,
    n_threads = n_threads
  )
  
  #convert to snn index
  
  #add cell ids as field
  rownames(nn_index$idx) = rownames(pc_coords)
  rownames(nn_index$dist) = rownames(pc_coords)
  
  #convert to snn graph via knn_to_snn function
  snn_graph = knn_to_snn_graph(nn_index)
  rownames(snn_graph) = rownames(nn_index$idx)
  colnames(snn_graph) = rownames(nn_index$idx)
  return(snn_graph)
}



#adapted from bpcells function
get_leiden_clustering_graph_results_from_igraph_function = function(snn_graph, resolution = .1) {
  #set random seed
  set.seed(1)
  objective_function = c("modularity")
  clustered_graph= igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(snn_graph, weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE, mode = "lower") 
  
  leiden_communities_found = clustered_graph %>% igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = resolution, objective_function=objective_function)
  
  #dendro stuff start
  
  
  #dendro stuff end
  leiden_communities_found %>% 
    igraph::membership() %>%
    as.factor()
}

#adapted from bpcells function
subcluster_assignments_and_modularity_score  = function(snn_graph, resolution = .1) {
  #set random seed
  set.seed(1)
  objective_function = c("modularity")
  clustered_graph= igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(snn_graph, weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE, mode = "lower") 
  
  leiden_communities_found = clustered_graph %>% igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = resolution, objective_function=objective_function)
  
  modularity_score = leiden_communities_found$quality
  cluster_assignments = leiden_communities_found$membership
  names(cluster_assignments) = leiden_communities_found$names
  
  list(modularity_score = modularity_score, new_assignments = cluster_assignments)
}

subcluster_cells_harmony = function(harmony_pcs, cur_cluster_name, modularity_threshold = .8, leiden_resolution = .1) {
  results_list = list()
  snn_graph = create_snn_graph_from_pcs(harmony_pcs)
  mod_score_and_assignments = subcluster_assignments_and_modularity_score(snn_graph, resolution = leiden_resolution)
  results_list$modularity_score = mod_score_and_assignments$modularity_score
  num_new_clusters = length(mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments %>% unique())
  if (mod_score_and_assignments$modularity_score > modularity_threshold & num_new_clusters > 1) {
      results_list$successful = T
      results_list$new_assignments = paste0(cur_cluster_name,"-",mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments)
      names(results_list$new_assignments) = names(mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments)
      results_list$pcs = harmony_pcs
      results_list$snn_graph = snn_graph
  } else{
    results_list$successful = F
    results_list$new_assignments = NA
  }
  return(results_list)
}

get_lognorm_markers = function(cluster_assignments, non_norm_ge) {
  assignments = cluster_assignments$new_assignments
  non_norm_ge = non_norm_ge[,names(assignments)]
  #log norm
  non_norm_ge = multiply_cols(non_norm_ge, 1/Matrix::colSums(non_norm_ge))
  non_norm_ge <- log1p(non_norm_ge * 1e6) # Log cpm
  
  #get markers
  markers_per_clust = marker_features(mat = non_norm_ge, assignments)
  markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(l2fc = (foreground_mean - background_mean)/log(2))
  markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(cpm_expression = 100*(2^foreground_mean - 1))

  markers_per_clust
}
```

1 - neuron (glutamatergic)
2 - olig (ST18/PLP1)
3 - astrocyte (AQP4/GFAP)
4 - t-cell (PTPRC/SKAP1)
5 - opc (PDGFRA/CSPG4) 
6- neuron (GABAergic)
7- microglia (TMEM119/AIF1)
8- vascular + VLMC (CLDN5/FLT1/DCN)
9,10 - singlet

```{r}
broadclass_df = readRDS("broad_cell_classes_integrated_dset.rds")
```

neurons
```{r}
neuronal_cells = broadclass_df %>% filter(cell_broadclass == "neuron") %>% pull(cell_ids)
neuronal_meta = combined_meta[match(neuronal_cells, combined_meta$cell_id),]
neuronal_ge = combined_ge[,neuronal_cells]
pcs_neuronal = get_pcs_from_initial_dataset(neuronal_ge)

#finds pcs after log normalization + z-scoring to get relative variance of gene in relation to distribution of that gene in the dataset
harmony_neuronal = RunHarmony(pcs_neuronal,meta_data = neuronal_meta$dataset)
neuronal_clusters = subcluster_cells_harmony(harmony_pcs = harmony_neuronal,cur_cluster_name = "neuronal", leiden_resolution = .1)
neuronal_markers = get_lognorm_markers(cluster_assignments = neuronal_clusters, non_norm_ge = neuronal_ge)
```
neurons:  4,7 - HDC (contamination/wrong regionh)
1,2,6,9 - lateral mb(kcnc2)
3,5- medial mb(foxb1)
8 - low kcnc2, no Foxb1, high Meis2
10 - other glutamatergic (EBF2/ST6GALNAC5/EPS8)

```{r}
# ---- 1. annotation lookup: single source of truth, edit only here ------------
# NOTE: rows without a "-N" suffix are broadclasses that were never subclustered.
# Verify those names against: unique(broadclass_df$cell_broadclass)
annotations = tribble(
  ~cluster_number, ~cluster,                                     ~final_cluster_assignment,   ~keep,
  # --- neurons -----------------------------------------------------------
  "neuronal-1",    "lateral MB neuron (KCNC2)",                  "lateral mammillary neuron",  TRUE,
  "neuronal-2",    "lateral MB neuron (KCNC2)",                  "lateral mammillary neuron",  TRUE,
  "neuronal-6",    "lateral MB neuron (KCNC2)",                  "lateral mammillary neuron",  TRUE,
  "neuronal-9",    "lateral MB neuron (KCNC2)",                  "lateral mammillary neuron",  TRUE,
  "neuronal-3",    "medial MB neuron (FOXB1)",                   "medial mammillary neuron",   TRUE,
  "neuronal-5",    "medial MB neuron (FOXB1)",                   "medial mammillary neuron",   TRUE,
  "neuronal-8",    "MEIS2+ neuron (KCNC2-low/FOXB1-neg)",        "MEIS2_KCNC2low_neuron",              TRUE,
  "neuronal-10",   "other glutamatergic (EBF2/ST6GALNAC5/EPS8)", "glutamatergic_EBF2_EPS8_neuron",       TRUE,
  "neuronal-4",    "HDC neuron (out-of-region)",                 NA,                           FALSE,
  "neuronal-7",    "HDC neuron (out-of-region)",                 NA,                           FALSE,
  # --- astrocytes --------------------------------------------------------
  "astrocyte-1",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-2",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-3",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-4",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-6",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-7",   "astrocyte",                                  "astrocyte",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-5",   "ependymal (CFAP299/TTC6)",                   "ependymal",                  TRUE,
  "astrocyte-8",   "exAM astrocyte",                             NA,                           FALSE,
  "astrocyte-9",   "OPC doublet",                                NA,                           FALSE,
  "astrocyte-10",  "choroid plexus (TTR/FOLR1/PRLR)",            NA,                           FALSE,
  # --- microglia ---------------------------------------------------------
  "microglia-1",   "microglia",                                  "microglia",                  TRUE,
  "microglia-2",   "microglia",                                  "microglia",                  TRUE,
  "microglia-3",   "exAM microglia",                             NA,                           FALSE,
  "microglia-4",   "singlet",                                    NA,                           FALSE,
  # --- vascular ----------------------------------------------------------
  "vascular-1",    "endothelial (CLDN5/FLT1)",                   "endothelial",                TRUE,
  "vascular-2",    "VLMC (PDGFRA/OGN)",                          "VLMC",                       TRUE,
)

# ---- 2. pool every subcluster assignment ------------------------------------
subcluster_vec = c(
  neuronal_clusters$new_assignments,
  astrocyte_clusters$new_assignments,
  microglia_clusters$new_assignments,
  vascular_clusters$new_assignments
)
subcluster_df = tibble(
  cell_id        = names(subcluster_vec),
  cluster_number = unname(subcluster_vec)
)
# ---- 3. build the final per-cell table ---------------------------------------
final_cluster_df = broadclass_df %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(cell_id = cell_ids, broadclass = cell_broadclass) %>%
  left_join(subcluster_df, by = "cell_id") %>%
  # cells in a broadclass that was never subclustered key off the broadclass itself
  mutate(cluster_number = coalesce(cluster_number, broadclass)) %>%
  left_join(annotations, by = "cluster_number") %>%
  select(cell_id, broadclass, cluster_number, cluster, final_cluster_assignment, keep)
final_cluster_df = final_cluster_df %>% 
  mutate(keep = case_when(
    broadclass %in% c("oligo","opc") ~ T,
    broadclass %in% c("singlet","t-cell")~F,
    .default = keep
  ))

final_cluster_df = final_cluster_df %>% 
  mutate(final_cluster_assignment = case_when(
    broadclass %in% c("oligo","opc") ~ broadclass,
    .default = final_cluster_assignment
  ))


final_cluster_df = final_cluster_df %>% left_join(combined_meta, by = "cell_id")
saveRDS(final_cluster_df, "final_cluster_assignments_integrated_dset.rds")
```
